records.title: Geopolymer Composite Coatings Based on Moroccan Clay and Sands for Restoration Application
records.reportedLicense: CC BY; article copyright section observed

notes.locator: Materials and Methods / Raw Materials; Coating Process
notes.finding: Potassium-silicate activation with metakaolin/calcined Moroccan clays; coatings consolidated for 72 hours before controlled-humidity or outdoor storage.
Limestone adhesion decreased at higher humidity; substrate-specific behavior prevents a universal bond-strength ranking.
Two clay-only formulations were rejected for spray application because consolidation was too slow or too fast.
